configuration.clock: time.monotonic_ns (host); select() reads; JSON encode/decode included
configuration.cold_policy: each cold trial starts a new serve process; first request = engine.info; world.create (spawns worker) untimed; first edit (install v2) timed
configuration.interleaving: v1/v2 alternate on every edit (world starts on v1)
configuration.serve_policy: fresh serve process per warm epoch; each epoch's world is in its own worker
configuration.warm_up_policy: per warm epoch: one untimed, verified warm-up edit (install v2) after world.create; the warm-up edit is excluded from samples

pmu.reason: not collected: no perf_event_open counters are used by this bench (PERFORMANCE.md section 5 makes them optional)

environment.shared_vm_note: 4 vCPU shared VM (hypervisor flag set). Timing here is not performance qualification (C10).
